name: Shadows In The Night reduces damage taken above 75% health (#594)
contract: Shadows In The Night 704662: 'While above 75% health, damage taken is reduced by $s1%.' The record's CasterAuraState is 23 (AURA_STATE_HEALTH_ABOVE_75_PERCENT, SharedDefines.h:1390) and effect 1 is aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN with MiscValue 127 (all schools) and BasePoints -6 / DieSides 1, i.e. -5%. Both halves are native: SpellAuraEffects.cpp:152 routes aura 87 through Unit::MeleeDamageBonus and Unit::SpellDamageBonus, and Unit.cpp:637 refreshes the aura state every update, with Unit::ModifyAuraState applying and removing the effects of every owned aura whose CasterAuraState matches. Effect 0 is an inert aura 4 marker. spell_damage_taken queries Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken with a fixed base of 1000 and `target` as the attacker, submitting no attack. The full-health reading is taken first because the harness has no fixture that restores maximum health, so the comparison runs protected then unprotected: 1 / 0.95 = 1.0526.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let Unit::Update refresh the aura state
Below 75% health the 5% reduction is gone
